title: GNUS.ai Distillation Strategy — Key Architectural Takeaways
scope_summary: 15 design principles for system-level cognitive distillation: multi-teacher selection, behavioral capture, role-based datasets, objective/subjective separation, routing/verification/memory/consensus/failure distillation, benchmark-per-specialist, cost-optimized teacher selection, continuous self-improvement, quantization-aware distillation, adapter-first architecture, and the principle that every pipeline stage produces reusable training data.
